Company Introduction

Welcome to Credit Care SA

We are South Africa's dedicated credit rehabilitation partner. Whether you are trapped under an outdated debt review flag, harassed by prescribed debt collectors, or blocked by default listings at credit bureaus, we clear your record legally under the National Credit Act.

100% Legal & NCR Compliant

Registered with the National Credit Regulator (NCRCP17108). All our dispute procedures adhere strictly to Sections 126B, 71, and 72 of the National Credit Act 34 of 2005.

Learn about our background →

Direct Bureau Updates

We liaise directly with all major South African credit bureaus including TransUnion, Experian, XDS, and Compuscan to ensure clearance certificates are registered immediately.

Clearance Protocol

How Credit Care SA Restores Your Freedom

A proven, four-step transparent journey from credit distress to bank pre-approval.

01

Free Comprehensive Credit Audit

We pull your official South African credit bureau files (TransUnion, Experian, XDS) and isolate every adverse tag, judgment, and debt review flag.

02

Legal Analysis & Dispute Filing

Our legal credit experts serve formal dispute notices under the National Credit Act. Unlawful collection fees and prescribed debts are legally barred.

03

Official Clearance Certificate

Credit bureaus update their databases to reflect cleared status. You receive formal Form 17.W or clearance certificates directly.

Need Urgent Debt Review Removal?

If you have settled your debts or were unlawfully placed under review, we can remove the flag in 7 to 21 working days.
